title: Chapter 642 - 642 Xia Xue; Banquet! (2)
content:
Chapter 642 - 642 Xia Xue; Banquet! (2)

Chapter 642 - 642 Xia Xue; Banquet! (2)

642 Xia Xue; Banquet! (2)

…

How would they know that this was Lin Fan’s doing?

One had to know…

Right now, Lin Fan possessed Perfect Ice Manipulation Skill and Perfect Water Manipulation Skill, as well as a massive amount of energy.

It was not difficult for Lin Fan to make the entire world snow, let alone Jiangbei alone.

…

On the other hand, the Xia officials had also noticed the heavy snow in Jiangbei.

They held a small emergency meeting.

Several men and women with extraordinary auras gathered.

Among them, the man sitting at the front let out a muffled sound.

“What’s with the heavy snow in Jiangbei?”

Sitting in the middle was a woman wearing red-rimmed glasses. Her hands were jumping rapidly on the keyboard.

Soon, she said, “A large area of cold air suddenly condensed at the location of the rain clouds, forming heavy snow.”

As she spoke, a 3D projection of a simulated snowfall appeared on the scene.

“If it’s a special ability user, what level will it take to do it?” asked the man in the front seat.

The woman pushed her red-rimmed glasses up her nose bridge and said, “SSS-rank!”

“Were there any SSS-rank special ability users in Jiangbei at that time?” the man asked.

“All the known SSS-rank aptitude users weren’t in Jiangbei at that time,” the woman replied.

The man thought for a moment and said, “Send out an announcement. The snow in Jiangbei is a rare natural phenomenon.”

The heavy snow in the north of the Yangtze River had settled down!

Not long after, Xia Daily published a piece of news.

[Today, a rare phenomenon occurred in Jiangbei City. In the heat of August, snow fell. It’s very strange.

[Please be reminded that when enjoying the snow scenery and playing with the snow, you should also take precautions such as keeping warm to avoid fever and catching a cold. Snow Scenery.jpg, Snow Scenery.jpg, Snow Scenery.jpg]

Then, some experts followed suit and discussed the phenomenon, conditions, and probability of cold air gathering.

They even mentioned the specific reason for the cold air gathering in Jiangbei.

It had to be said that these people really spewed some stuff just to gain traffic and attention.

The effect was also quite good.

Although many people did not quite understand what they meant, they just thought that the experts were knowledgeable and capable!

Therefore, they all paid attention and supported them.

…

Lin Fan did not care about these things at all.

He just silently watched Xia Xue play with the snow and build a snowman. He was also very happy.

At this moment, a magnetic voice suddenly sounded not far away.

“Xia Xue, are you playing with the snow here?”

After Xia Xue heard the voice, she turned around and looked over.

A silver-white hover car was parked beside them, and inside it sat an oval-faced woman in a long gauze dress.

Xia Xue smiled. “It’s rare for snow to fall in Jiangbei.”

“I don’t like snow. It’s too cold!” What was going on today? It was August, but it was snowing so heavily.

“Aren’t you going to change? It won’t be long before the banquet begins.”

Xia Xue was slightly stunned.

Banquet?

That was right!

There was a grand banquet for the student council officers at Jiangbei University today.

She had actually forgotten about it.

“By the way, have you found a male partner? If not, why don’t we let Chen Minghe join us?

“He’s handsome and quite capable…”

Xia Xue quickly interrupted, “Weiya, thank you for your kindness. But I’ve already found a partner.

“Let me introduce you. This is Lin Fan.”

Then, Xia Xue threw a pleading look at Lin Fan.

Xia Xue had a good impression of Lin Fan.

Firstly, he was handsome.

In addition, for some reason, he gave Xia Xue a very special sense of security.

As for Chen Ming, she had a bad impression of him.

He was cunning and had ulterior motives about her.

…

Xia Xue did not need to beg Lin Fan to be her companion for a banquet.

Lin Fan was extremely happy.

He smiled and said, “Hello, Weiya. I’m Lin Fan, Xia Xue’s dance partner tonight.”

Dai Weiya sized Lin Fan up.

Her first impression was that he was so handsome and tall!

A hint of jealousy crept into her heart.

After a while, she said, “Xia Xue, since you’ve found a dance partner, then I won’t say much. See you at the banquet!”

As soon as she finished speaking, the hover car set off a gust of wind and quickly drove into the distance.

At this point, only Lin Fan and Xia Xue were left.

Even though they were on a wide street, the air suddenly became a little heavy for some reason.

After a while, Xia Xue stuttered, “Uhh… Thank you for helping me out… I’ll go back to school first.”

Lin Fan looked at Xia Xue’s confused appearance and could not help but find her very cute. He smiled and said, “It’s getting late. Let’s go to school together. We still have to attend the banquet later.”

Xia Xue was slightly shy, and she stuttered, “Alright…Alright.”

Then, the two of them walked forward side by side. From afar… they were like a sweet couple.

In the live broadcast room…

First Affection Card: [Lin Fan and Xia Xue are so sweet!]

Xiao Fei: [This… Did I enter the wrong live broadcast Doesn’t Xia Xue usually visit shops and restricted areas? What’s with the PDA?]

Forest: [Is this the feeling of being in love? It’s really, really enviable!]

Jie Rou: [Xiao Xue is so cute. Lin Fan is so handsome! I’m in favor of this couple!]

Action is Worse Than Excitement: [Do you think Xia Xue forgot to turn off the live broadcast?]

Rainy Season: [It seems… she did.]

Sprout: [I’m looking forward to the live broadcast of the banquet later.]

…

Lin Fan and Xia Xue walked on the snow-covered road, constantly making squeaking sounds. It was very interesting.

After passing through two small paths covered in snow…

Finally, a tall and majestic building appeared in his sight.

It was Jiangbei University!

Their entries were successful upon getting their faces scanned!

Lin Fan and Xia Xue continued forward.

Not long after, they arrived in front of an oval-shaped building.

This place… was the venue of tonight’s banquet.

At this moment, the energetic students were either chatting or laughing as they slowly walked in.

Xia Xue thought about it and said, “Actually, it’s fine to just eat at the banquet later. Later, you can eat whatever you want.”

Lin Fan looked at her embarrassed expression and could not help but laugh. “Alright.”

Thus, the two of them walked in.

As Xia Xue said, the banquet was centered on eating.

As soon as they walked in, they could see a circle of food. The air was filled with the aroma of food.

Students were chatting and picking up food from the plates. The atmosphere was very relaxed.

It had to be said that the world a thousand years later was indeed a little different from a thousand years ago.

A thousand years ago, even though Jiangbei University was a top university and the students had good resources, things would definitely not be like this.

It was just a student dinner, yet there was no lack of abalone, lobster, sea cucumber, M9 beef, crab, red wine, and other delicacies and drinks.

Lin Fan placed two pieces of beef into his mouth and commented in his heart, ‘The meat quality is not bad. Unfortunately, the taste is rather ordinary. Moreover, regardless of whether the meat is salty, spicy, sweet, or even thin… They’re all exactly the same!

“The meat is clean-tasting and uniform, but it’s easy to get tired of. The food must’ve been cooked by a machine.”

And the truth was just as Lin Fan had guessed.

At this moment, a slightly ear-piercing voice sounded not far away.

“Xia Xue, your speed is so fast!

“By the way, why didn’t you change into an evening gown?”

Xia Xue and Lin Fan heard the voice and turned to look.

The person who spoke was none other than Dai Weiya, whom they had met not long ago.

There was a man in a tuxedo beside Dai Weiya.

When the man in the tuxedo saw Xia Xue, a smile appeared on his face.

But when he saw Lin Fan, his face sank.
